verdict.rationale: Stripe's documented MCP server lets an agent read payouts and balance transactions through any API GET method. Its `stripe_report` tool can also create payouts and balance report runs as downloadable CSVs, so the data-pulling half of the story is directly supported. The evidence does not show how a payout is linked to the specific charges it settled, so the deposit-to-charge reconciliation itself is only implied. Missing for 10: documented payout-to-charge linkage (e.g. listing balance transactions by payout or a payout reconciliation report), any reconciliation workflow, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent pull payout and balance-transaction data via the API and reconcile each bank deposit to its underlying charges

citations.quote: `stripe_api_read` ("Read data with any Stripe API GET method")
Connect accounts, Issuing, tax registrations/calculations, payouts, and balance transactions

`stripe_report` "searches available financial report types and creates report runs for reports such as balance, payouts, activity, tax, and Revenue Recognition. Report runs generate downloadable CSV files."
Stripe sends funds from your available balance to your bank account as payouts
